Adds Mistral model provider support to Carapace.

## Distribution

- Package: `@carapace/mistral-provider`
- Install route: npm or ClawHub: `clawhub:@carapace/mistral-provider`

## Surface

- Providers: `mistral`
- Contracts: `embeddingProviders`, `mediaUnderstandingProviders`, `realtimeTranscriptionProviders`
